verses.text: Look! Praise Yahweh, all you servants of Yahweh, who stand by night in Yahweh’s house!
lines: Look! Praise Yahweh, all you servants of Yahweh,
who stand by night in Yahweh’s house!

verses.text: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary. Praise Yahweh!
lines: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary.

verses.text: May Yahweh bless you from Zion, even he who made heaven and earth.
lines: May Yahweh bless you from Zion,
even he who made heaven and earth.
